description: The person's own horoscope for today, read on her birth chart exactly as the Asteria app's home screen reads it: the transit that leads her day (the app's ranking of every contact between today's sky and her chart), the app's text for that day (a hook and what the day brings her, what to do with it), where the transit stands (peaking today, until a date), then the Moon of the day in her natal house with its text, and the house the Moon reaches tomorrow. Needs her birth date, time and place. Use it for "my horoscope", "my day", "what's in store for me today".

current_timezone.description: IANA time zone where she is today, which cuts her day (default: her birth time zone).

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place of birth (where the person was born, never where the user is now), degrees, north positive.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place of birth (where the person was born, never where the user is now), degrees, east positive.

time.description: Birth time on the local clock of the birth place, HH:MM (24-hour). Optional when unknown.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birth place (e.g. Europe/Paris, America/New_York, America/Sao_Paulo). Required with a time.

name: my_day
title: My horoscope today (personal)
